query:
UPDATE downloads
        SET callback_url = $1, auth_token = $2, callback_sent_at = NULL, import_confirmed_at = NULL,
            status = CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 'completed' ELSE status END,
            error = CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN NULL ELSE error END,
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $3
